dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, how do you stay motivated when you're tired?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈsteɪ ˈmoʊtəveɪtɪd wɛn jʊr ˈtaɪərd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I remind myself why I'm doing this. That helps me stay positive.
dialogue.reading: aɪ rɪˈmaɪnd maɪˈsɛlf ˈwaɪ aɪm ˈduːɪŋ ˈðɪs. ðæt ˈhɛlps miː ˈsteɪ ˈpɑːzətɪv.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. And how do you stay focused when you study?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ənd ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈsteɪ ˈfoʊkəst wɛn juː ˈstʌdi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I keep my phone in another room. With my phone next to me, I can't stay focused for long.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkiːp maɪ ˈfoʊn ɪn əˈnʌðər ˈruːm. wɪð maɪ ˈfoʊn ˈnɛkst tə miː, aɪ ˈkænt ˈsteɪ ˈfoʊkəst fər ˈlɔːŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Smart. Are you an organized person?
dialogue.reading: ˈsmɑːrt. ər juː ən ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd ˈpɜːrsən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I try to be. I write a to-do list every morning, so I stay organized.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈtraɪ tə ˈbiː. aɪ ˈraɪt ə təˈduː ˈlɪst ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, soʊ aɪ ˈsteɪ ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What time of day are you most productive?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm əv ˈdeɪ ər juː ˈmoʊst prəˈdʌktɪv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Early in the morning. After lunch, I always feel sleepy!
dialogue.reading: ˈɜːrli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. ˈæftər ˈlʌntʃ, aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈfiːl ˈsliːpi!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Lots of people feel that way. Do you take breaks?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɑːts əv ˈpiːpəl ˈfiːl ˈðæt ˈweɪ. duː juː ˈteɪk ˈbreɪks?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Every hour, I go for a short walk. It keeps me calm.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈɛvri ˈaʊər, aɪ ˈɡoʊ fər ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈwɔːk. ɪt ˈkiːps miː ˈkɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a good habit. When things go wrong, try to remain calm, too.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈhæbɪt. wɛn ˈθɪŋz ˈɡoʊ ˈrɔːŋ, ˈtraɪ tə rɪˈmeɪn ˈkɑːm, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'll try. Staying calm before exams is the hardest part for me!
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈtraɪ. ˈsteɪɪŋ ˈkɑːm bɪˈfɔːr ɪɡˈzæmz ɪz ðə ˈhɑːrdɪst ˈpɑːrt fər miː!
